    Every key, accounted for.

    SmartLocker cabinets record who took a key, when they took it, and when it came back.

    2 of 7

    Opens for the right person.

    Staff sign in with a PIN, a swipe card or a fingerprint. The door unlocks and only the keys they're cleared for are released.

    3 of 7

    Who has key 3? You know.

    Every key carries an RFID tag. The moment it leaves its slot, the cabinet logs the name and the time, and its light stays amber until it's back.

    4 of 7

    What's inside.

    Locking slots hold each key until someone cleared asks for it. A backup battery keeps the cabinet working through a power outage.

    5 of 7

    Grows with your site.

    Add key and locker modules as you need them, all managed as one system.

    Every location, one dashboard.

    Cabinets report to the cloud, so you can check the log, run reports and get overdue alerts from anywhere.

    Our expertise.

    Key cabinets, trackers, safes and lockers. Every one signs people in, logs every event and reports to the same dashboard.

    Smart Key Systems

    Electronic key cabinets with RFID key slots and PIN, card or fingerprint sign-in. Modular, so a cabinet grows from a dozen keys to several hundred.

    Smart Tracker

    GPS tracking, so you know where a key or vehicle is, not just who signed it out.

    Wall Unit

    A compact wall-mounted key cabinet for smaller sites and satellite offices.

    Safe Units

    Heavy-duty safes for high-security keys, cash and valuables, with the same access control and audit trail.

    Locker, Storage and Gun System

    Electronic lockers for radios, devices, evidence and firearms, each door released only to the right person.
